hypotheses.rationale: Regional opens can concentrate information processing and liquidity demand.
hypotheses.required_data: M1/M5 bid/ask prices and timezone-aware session labels
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: spread and fast liquidity replenishment erase open drift
hypotheses.possible_confounders: DST, holidays, macro announcements, opening spread spikes
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: continuation fails if net return is not positive in at least 70 percent of discovery folds

hypotheses.rationale: Opening imbalances may overshoot and mean-revert once liquidity deepens.
hypotheses.required_data: M1/M5 bid/ask prices and timezone-aware session labels
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: open move reflects durable information rather than transient pressure
hypotheses.possible_confounders: session overlap, news clustering, roll exclusion
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: reversal fails if stress_1 net performance is non-positive

hypotheses.rationale: Runs of signed quote changes may proxy short-lived order-flow imbalance.
hypotheses.required_data: quote-derived signed mid changes, spread, realized volatility and quote-run length
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: quote-run proxy is mostly bid-ask bounce or stale quote refresh
hypotheses.possible_confounders: quote clustering, missing quote bursts, spread widening
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if bid/ask executable returns disappear after one-bar latency

hypotheses.rationale: Compression followed by expansion may mark intraday repricing.
hypotheses.required_data: M1/M5 high-low range, realized variance and session-relative range percentile
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: breakouts are too late after executable costs
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if parameter-neighborhood stability does not pass

hypotheses.rationale: Spread, gap and abnormal return shocks can mark temporary liquidity dislocations.
hypotheses.required_data: spread z-score, quote gaps, one-bar returns, bid/ask update asymmetry
hypotheses.signal_definition_class: post-shock reversal after completed shock bar
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: shock contains persistent information or no executable quote appears
hypotheses.possible_confounders: holiday liquidity, data gaps, central-bank announcements
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails on any unresolved execution-integrity violation

hypotheses.rationale: Net returns may improve when independent signals are executed only in forecast low-cost states.
hypotheses.required_data: frozen directional signals plus lagged spread and liquidity predictors
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: filter removes winners or forecasts costs poorly
hypotheses.possible_confounders: cost savings confused with directional alpha
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: must report execution alpha separately from directional alpha

hypotheses.rationale: Economically linked pairs may adjust with small lags when liquidity differs.
hypotheses.required_data: strictly lagged M1/M5 returns for related pair graph
hypotheses.signal_definition_class: lagged source-pair return predicting target-pair executable return
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: lag disappears after synchronization and costs
hypotheses.possible_confounders: contemporaneous leakage, stale bars, common USD shock
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if any target return after signal cutoff enters features

hypotheses.rationale: Residuals from lagged currency-factor estimates may mean-revert or continue.
hypotheses.required_data: nine-pair graph returns and rolling or expanding lagged factor estimates
hypotheses.signal_definition_class: residual continuation or residual mean reversion
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: factor residual mostly reflects noise and spread
hypotheses.possible_confounders: rank deficiency, USD common shock, JPY concentration
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if factor estimation uses full-sample or future smoothing

hypotheses.rationale: Triangular price relationships may leave transient residuals, but only executable legs matter.
hypotheses.required_data: bid/ask prices for EURJPY/EURUSD/USDJPY, GBPJPY/GBPUSD/USDJPY, AUDJPY/AUDUSD/USDJPY
hypotheses.signal_definition_class: single-leg, two-leg hedge or three-leg executable basket convergence
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: mid residual is not executable after all bid/ask costs
hypotheses.possible_confounders: asynchronous quote timestamps, stale legs, multi-leg fill risk
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if basket uses mid-price discrepancy as arbitrage

hypotheses.rationale: Pairs with strong lagged normalized returns may continue or reverse intraday.
hypotheses.required_data: lagged volatility-normalized returns across nine pairs
hypotheses.signal_definition_class: top-minus-bottom, currency-neutral, USD-beta-neutral or JPY-beta-neutral allocation
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: cross-sectional signal concentrates in one instrument or costlier pairs
hypotheses.possible_confounders: neutrality estimate leakage, duplicated currency exposures
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if no neutrality calculation is lagged

hypotheses.rationale: Timezone cells can encode recurring liquidity, spread and volatility patterns.
hypotheses.required_data: prior-year cell statistics, session clock, day-of-week and holiday-adjacent flags
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: seasonality is cost or liquidity pattern, not directional alpha
hypotheses.possible_confounders: full-sample cell leakage, sparse cells, DST
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if any cell statistic uses same-year future observations

hypotheses.rationale: Trend and reversal may depend on lagged volatility, liquidity and correlation regimes.
hypotheses.required_data: lagged volatility, spread, trend strength, cross-pair correlation and dispersion
hypotheses.signal_definition_class: fixed-bin, HMM-filtered or Gaussian-mixture-filtered regime conditioning
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: regime model overfits or future smoothing leaks
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if regime probability is smoothed with future data

hypotheses.rationale: Strictly lagged nonlinear feature interactions may predict when net executable return is positive.
hypotheses.required_data: registered feature matrix, cost-aware labels and fold-local fitted transforms
hypotheses.failure_mechanism: model overfits costs, regimes or sparse instruments
hypotheses.possible_confounders: feature selection leakage, seed mining, class imbalance
hypotheses.preregistered_falsification_test: fails if any fitted preprocessing uses observations outside the fold
